added: Native Android LAN agent implementing devlink-spec v0.2.0: foreground HTTP service on port 8787, private/local source filtering, Bearer token (also written to the app files dir for adb), NSD discovery as _as-devlink._tcp, start on boot.
Core endpoints /v1/info, /v1/extensions, /v1/status with RFC 9457 problem responses.

Extensions: device.battery, network.wifi (state, best-effort reconnect, Wi-Fi lock), android.adb (wireless debugging on/off, auto-enable after boot and Wi-Fi reconnect), power.keep-awake (stay on while plugged in), display.screenshot (PNG/JPEG via AccessibilityService, no adb needed).
Sensitive extensions (android.adb, power.keep-awake, display.screenshot) are disabled by default and enabled with switches on the device.
